title: Lane Attestor: traffic gating with resume-safe rollback and payload-sanitized shadowing
author: Marina Lopez
release_notes: Introduces the Lane Attestor component: a lightweight attestation layer that gates canary and shadow traffic based on fast semantic smoke checks, payload sanitization, and session-safe rollback anchors. Adds operator playbook and Helm values for Private deployments.
description: Context: As we scale multi-stage rollouts (shadow -> canary -> promote) we observed rare but user-visible regressions caused by payload-sensitive model behavior and partial session handoffs. This PR implements a 'Lane Attestor' that augments our rollout pipeline with: 1) real-time attestation signals (smoke test pass, schema conformance, hallucination proxy score) used as gates; 2) sanitized shadowing for A/B analysis to avoid leaking broken inputs to downstream services; 3) resume-safe rollback anchors that preserve session affinity and allow immediate traffic rewinds without dropping in-flight sessions. What changed (high level): - New attestor core and policy engine (serving/orchestrator/attestor) that evaluates per-cohort signals and emits gate decisions. - Shadow proxy: sanitizes and tags shadow payloads, forwards them to variant replicas and to the replay buffer. - Rollback anchors: checkpointed session leases and lightweight snapshotting so a rollback can rehydrate session state and resume with the previous model variant. - Operator surface: Helm values, console flags, and a runbook for manual intervention. - Tests: unit, integration, and an e2e canary-sim harness. Rollout plan: staged rollout through Dedicated -> Hosted: 0.1 -> 0.25 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 with 30-minute holdpoints. Automatic rollback triggers: (a) latency P95 increase > 35% for 10 minutes; (b) hallucination-proxy rate > 3% absolute increase vs baseline for 10 minutes; (c) HTTP error rate > 0.5% absolute increase for 5 minutes. Manual operator steps documented in docs/runbooks/lane-attestor-playbook.md. Checklist: - [x] Core attestor runtime implemented - [x] Shadow sanitization + replay buffer integration - [x] Rollback anchors + session checkpoint tests - [x] Helm chart values and kube manifests - [x] Console feature flag + dashboards - [x] E2E canary simulation harness - [x] Docs/playbook and Linear tickets linked Testing notes: unit and integration tests added; canary-sim replicates production traffic distribution and validates rollback anchor behavior. Metrics to watch: token-level cost, P95 latency, hallucination-proxy rate, end-to-end success rate, replay buffer lag. Related: ENG-1942 (attestor design doc), ENG-2067 (session checkpointing), SUP-342 (customer incident that motivated safe rollbacks).
